snippet.title: Last Flag | The Showdown
snippet.description:
What happens when two of Last Flag’s fiercest competitors share the same couch? Find out in The Showdown.

This video premiered during Future Games Show's Spring Showcase on March 12, 2026.

Last Flag launches on Steam and Epic Games Store on April 14, 2026. Console versions for PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S will follow in Summer 2026.

Steam - https://bit.ly/4bEdlZO
Epic - https://bit.ly/3NxRGcA
